video_title: Damian Lillard Postgame Interview | Nov. 17, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on the frustration of losing a close game
quotes.excerpt: It's very frustrating to say, especially when you take control of the game.
quotes.quote: It's very frustrating to say, especially when you take control of the game. I thought we executed pretty well down the stretch for that. We managed those last five minutes pretty well, even though we had three or four threes in a row in big possessions. I thought we flowed around. They made timely shots and we probably could have done a little bit better, but for the most part, I thought we managed it well. We put ourselves in position to win on the second night of a back-to-back on the road, and they made the plays in those last couple possessions and we didn't.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard on the frustration of losing a close game after leading late: It is very frustrating to say, especially when you take control of the game. We put ourselves in position to win on the second night of a back to back on the road.

structured.context: Damian Lillard discusses the team's performance and frustration following a close loss on the road.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard evaluates J.K. Dobbins' performance in his debut
quotes.excerpt: It's tough in this league when you don't know if you're going to be suited up.
quotes.quote: I thought he did great. It's tough in this league when you don't know if you're going to be suited up, you don't know if you're going to get DNP, you don't know if you're going to play some minutes, somebody going to be in foul trouble, if you're going to be starting like he did tonight. You just never know. For me as somebody who's never been in that position, I got a lot of respect for guys who have to take that route where it's so unpredictable. I remember talking to him before the trip and he didn't even know he was coming on the trip. It speaks to his preparation and how much this means to him. I thought he played great, fought hard defensively, took shots when they were there, and he played an important role in us being in the position that we were in at the end of the game.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard praised J.K. Dobbins for his debut performance: It speaks to his preparation and how much this means to him. I thought he played great, fought hard defensively, took shots when they were there, and he played an important role.

structured.context: Damian Lillard praises teammate J.K. Dobbins for his performance and preparation during his debut game.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on adjusting his game with teammates sidelined
quotes.excerpt: With Danny out, I knew I would have more responsibility, just kind of managing the game.
quotes.quote: With Danny out, I knew I would have more responsibility, just kind of managing the game, scoring the ball, making plays. But just knowing they are a good defensive team and I didn't want to wear myself out out the gate by trying to just go for it. I've been in that position a lot in my career and I knew that I would have to balance it out, play a good floor game and pick my spots. So I spent most of the first half, I came out, took shots that were there, but the reads that were there, I took them. I hit the pocket, I reversed the ball, I advanced the ball to soften them up and eventually once it softened up, I was able to find a stretch. And then from there, I thought I was able to kind of play the balance game, keep them off balance, if they up this time, hit the pocket. I was able to set up my game that way like I always have.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard on adjusting his game with teammates sidelined: I knew I would have more responsibility, just kind of managing the game, scoring the ball, making plays. I knew that I would have to balance it out, play a good floor game.
